related.title: I/Q 接收機：EVM 的平方和與誤差來源
related.titleEn: I/Q receiver: EVM energy sums and error mechanisms
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 11.1111111111 % 與 33.3333333333 %，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 11.1111111111 % and 33.3333333333 %, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋5 %與10 %，建立iq_energy.csv、誤差向量圖、校正設定紀錄，並完成以下驗收：題設8%門檻僅第一組通過；報告校正設定，避免把共同相位補償後數字與未補償者比較。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 5 % and 10 %; create iq_energy.csv, error-vector plot and correction settings; apply this acceptance decision: Only the first case meets the teaching8% limit; disclose correction settings before comparing measurements.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 單音傳統AM的兩邊帶合計功率為Pc*m²/2；總功率Pc*(1+m²/2)，效率m²/(2+m²)。 展開基準式 0.5**2/(2+0.5**2)*100；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐項列載波與兩邊帶功率1.25 W、5 W，再除總功率11.25 W、15 W；功率守恆。 將兩條推導一起存入 am_power.csv、載波/邊帶圖、包絡零交叉檢查。

從原理 EVMrms=sqrt(sum(abs(error)²)/sum(abs(reference)²))；須先定義參考星座及是否校正共同增益與相位。 展開基準式 sqrt(0.25/100)*100；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用四個等能量誤差子群加總，重現總能量；把EVM平方回去應還原0.0025及0.01。 將兩條推導一起存入 iq_energy.csv、誤差向量圖、校正設定紀錄。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Single-tone conventional AM has total sideband power Pc*m²/2 and total power Pc*(1+m²/2), giving efficiency m²/(2+m²)., expand baseline expression 0.5**2/(2+0.5**2)*100; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: List sideband totals1.25 W and5 W, then divide by total powers11.25 W and15 W; verify power conservation. Save both derivations with am_power.csv, carrier/sideband diagram and envelope zero-crossing checks.

Starting from RMS EVM is sqrt(sum(abs(error)²)/sum(abs(reference)²)); define the reference constellation and common gain/phase correction first., expand baseline expression sqrt(0.25/100)*100; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Sum four equal-energy error subgroups; squaring EVM as a ratio must recover0.0025 and0.01. Save both derivations with iq_energy.csv, error-vector plot and correction settings.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LTE 換手：中斷窗口與語音緩衝
related.titleEn: LTE handover: interruption window and voice buffering
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 11.1111111111 % 與 33.3333333333 %，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 11.1111111111 % and 33.3333333333 %, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋400 byte與960 byte，建立handover_timeline.csv、緩衝占用曲線、雙路徑時間戳，並完成以下驗收：512 byte教學緩衝只足以涵蓋名義50 ms；還需檢查封包取整與播放時限。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 400 byte and 960 byte; create handover_timeline.csv, buffer occupancy and old/new-path timestamps; apply this acceptance decision: A512-byte teaching buffer covers nominal50 ms only; verify packet rounding and playout deadlines separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 單音傳統AM的兩邊帶合計功率為Pc*m²/2；總功率Pc*(1+m²/2)，效率m²/(2+m²)。 展開基準式 0.5**2/(2+0.5**2)*100；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐項列載波與兩邊帶功率1.25 W、5 W，再除總功率11.25 W、15 W；功率守恆。 將兩條推導一起存入 am_power.csv、載波/邊帶圖、包絡零交叉檢查。
從原理 連續媒體可由緩衝吸收有限中斷；所需緩衝至少為到達速率乘服務中斷，但不能掩蓋無限延遲。 展開基準式 64000*0.05/8；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：依20 ms媒體封包畫離散到達線；連續模型須向上取整到完整封包容量。 將兩條推導一起存入 handover_timeline.csv、緩衝占用曲線、雙路徑時間戳。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Single-tone conventional AM has total sideband power Pc*m²/2 and total power Pc*(1+m²/2), giving efficiency m²/(2+m²)., expand baseline expression 0.5**2/(2+0.5**2)*100; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: List sideband totals1.25 W and5 W, then divide by total powers11.25 W and15 W; verify power conservation. Save both derivations with am_power.csv, carrier/sideband diagram and envelope zero-crossing checks.

Starting from A buffer can absorb bounded media interruption; required storage is arrival rate times interruption, without eliminating latency., expand baseline expression 64000*0.05/8; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Draw arrivals of20 ms media packets; round the continuous estimate up to whole packet storage. Save both derivations with handover_timeline.csv, buffer occupancy and old/new-path timestamps.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
